evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: This paper proposes CCRV-Bench, a constraint-driven visual causal reasoning benchmark for single-image physical scenarios.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated excellent performance in visual tasks, but their visual causal reasoning capabilities still lack reliable evaluation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across 15 multimodal models show that constraint sensitivity is task- and model-dependent: intervention has the largest average effective degradation among the four causal tasks, spatial grounding is the most damaging constraint on average, and the factual adversarial constraint improves DCR for all evaluated models.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: These results show that unconstrained performance does not determine constrained robustness and that a single aggregate score can obscure distinct failures in causal identification, spatial grounding, and constraint-compliant expression.
